MPatcher optional Legacy network helper — third-party components

Unmodified binary provenance: Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube tag 1.9.9a
https://github.com/Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube/releases/tag/1.9.9a
The five shipped binaries/data files were checked against the Git blob hashes
of this tag. The MachineCraft IP list and restricted kernel filter are MPatcher
configuration; the packet strategy remains fake/repeats12/cutoff n2.

zapret winws v72.9: bol-van, MIT license (Flowseal-LICENSE.txt).
Source: zapret-72.9-source.zip, https://github.com/bol-van/zapret/tree/v72.9
WinDivert 2.2.2: basil00 contributors, LGPLv3 or GPLv2 (WinDivert-LICENSE.txt).
Source: WinDivert-2.2.2-source.zip, https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert/tree/v2.2.2
Cygwin API DLL 3.4.10: Cygwin contributors, LGPLv3+ and Cygwin Linking Exception.
Source package: cygwin-3.4.10-1-src.tar.xz, containing upstream source and cygport.
https://ftp.cvut.cz/mirrors/cygwin.com/x86_64/release/cygwin/cygwin-3.4.10-1-src.tar.xz
https://cygwin.com/licensing.html

The source archives are included with this distribution. No modifications to
these executables, DLLs, driver or fake packet have been made. Third-party
components are separate from the MPatcher game assembly. No generic Discord,
YouTube or browser filter profiles or their service scripts are installed.
